left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Psoriatic patients that are treated in our institute

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients suffering from cardiovascular diseases (peripheral vascular disease,congestive heart failure, status post cerebrovascular accident)

left.raw_text: -  Conditions that are harmful to the inner ear (chronic renal failure,history of noise exposure, usage of ototoxic drugs, chronic otitis media, [OR]  ear surgery in the past, significant head trauma in the past, ear drum perforation)
-  participant that complains of vertigo/ [OR]  dizziness/ [OR]  unsteadiness

right.raw_text: -  Participant who is/ was suffering from known inner ear disease: meniere disease, [OR]  acoustic neurinoma, [OR]  vestibular neuronitis
